answer: Each agent identity must post a fixed staking bond held in escrow, so a Sybil fleet needs one fully funded deposit per identity and cannot reuse a single bond across forged keys. Any proven misbehavior slashes the whole position, so the attacker's cost per fake agent stays at full collateral plus hardware attestation, never the price of a fresh key. Cluster tracing acts as an atlas of shared payers, making colluding identities visible, while bond rebates stay a whisper beside the frozen capital and the jetty of locked deposits that no forged identity can cross cheaply.
